[Doc 1] Leader of Fine Gael:  Since 2 June 2017, the office had been held by Leo Varadkar following the resignation of Enda Kenny.

[Doc 2] Fine Gael leadership election, 2017:  On 2 June Leo Varadkar was announced as the victor, beating rival Simon Coveney 60% to 40%.

[Doc 3] Leo Varadkar: Leo Eric Varadkar ( ; Irish: "Leo de Varad" ;born 18 January 1979) is an Irish Fine Gael politician who has served as Taoiseach, Minister for Defence and Leader of Fine Gael since June 2017.

[Doc 4] Simon Coveney: Simon Anthony Coveney (born 16 June 1972) is an Irish Fine Gael politician who has served as Minister for Foreign Affairs and Trade and Deputy Leader of Fine Gael since June 2017.

[Doc 5] Fine Gael leadership election, 2017: The 2017 Fine Gael leadership election was triggered in May 2017, when Enda Kenny resigned as party leader.
